title: Rain-soaked Suitcase
text: Spatial-biome treasure orbs have a separate 5% chance to contain this suitcase. Right-click to awaken Arcanist and The Storm immediately, without consuming it. Existing talents or curses are never overwritten.
Neither can be removed manually. The Cleansing Ritual removes both.
Sneak-use on the ground to place it open. Use an item to display one; use an empty hand to retrieve it. The case stays half-open while displaying an item.
Placing Voyager's Violin inside starts continuous music, granting Regeneration II and Resistance II to living creatures within 10 blocks. Remove the violin to stop.
